criteria.original_task: Derive both payload publication and slot-reuse happens-before chains for capacity4.
criteria.original_expected: Producer payload precedes release head; consumer acquire head precedes read. Consumer read precedes release tail; producer acquire tail precedes overwrite. Own-index relaxed loads do not replace these cross-party edges.

changed_conditions.task: Batch records and prove the admitted batch publication/reuse boundaries without inserting a second writer.

criteria.original_task: Start head and tail atUINT32_MAX-1, enqueue4 values then reject a fifth and drain.
criteria.original_expected: Unsigned difference remains bounded0..4 across wrap; mask selects slots. Empty leaves output unchanged and FULL cannot overwrite unread payload.

changed_conditions.task: Change unsigned width and require capacity below the unambiguous distance bound before reusing the arithmetic proof.

criteria.original_task: Remove release/acquire and observe no failure on x86 in finite runs.
criteria.original_expected: Absence of observation is not a portable C proof. Plain payload races require synchronization; target instruction behavior, atomic lock-freedom and false sharing are separate facts.

changed_conditions.task: Compare cache-line-separated indices under equal semantics and report timing apart from sanitizer/model evidence.

criteria.original_task: One caller repeatedly loses CAS while another succeeds; classify system and per-call progress.
criteria.original_expected: Successful interference can witness system progress while one caller starves. This is not a bounded wait-free guarantee; include allocation, reclamation and logging paths.

changed_conditions.task: Add a blocking allocator to an otherwise lock-free loop and revise the end-to-end classification.

criteria.original_task: Reserve tickets0 and1, publish1, pause owner0 and call pop.
criteria.original_expected: FIFO safety requires RETRY at unpublished0 even though1 isready. This reservation queue is deliberately blocking under the stalled owner, not Michael-Scott helping.

changed_conditions.task: Add cancellation tombstones and define when a skipped reserved ticket preserves the new sequential contract.

criteria.original_task: Inject weak-CAS spurious failure and stale expected values near integer maximum.
criteria.original_expected: Failure must refresh or reobserve expected state; unsigned/signed overflow policy must be explicit. A missing mutex API is not proof that compiler atomic helpers are lock-free.

changed_conditions.task: Inspect a wider atomic type whose lowering may call libatomic and provide an alternative admitted representation.

criteria.original_task: Pause a pop after reading headA,nextB; another caller removesA/B and reusesA before the stale CAS.
criteria.original_expected: Pointer bitsA can match while nextB is a stale incarnation. CAS equality alone does not validate that successor or permit its dereference.

changed_conditions.task: Reuse the same allocation for a different node type and separate effective-type/lifetime failure from abstract ABA.

criteria.original_task: Use a two-bit tag starting1 and perform four reuses.
criteria.original_expected: Tag returns1; finite tagging postpones ABA unless reuse is bounded or storage retires. The actual identity pool retires after65535 rather than wrapping.

changed_conditions.task: Derive a maximum reuse count under a bounded reader pause and explain which premise makes a finite tag sufficient.

criteria.original_task: Compare a generation-valid handle check with hazard-protected dereference.
criteria.original_expected: Checking identity does not itself pin lifetime against concurrent release. Hazard publication/revalidation or another lifetime protocol is required before reading reclaimed storage.

changed_conditions.task: Pause between validation and dereference and demonstrate the minimal local invalidation trace using synthetic nodes.

criteria.original_task: Partition32 nodes among dummy, live queued, retired protected, reserved enqueuer and free states.
criteria.original_expected: Every slot belongs to exactly one ownership state; abstract queue vacancy need not imply allocatable storage. FULL is a valid bounded-resource result.

changed_conditions.task: Pause all four participants holding hazards and derive the remaining admissible enqueue capacity.

criteria.original_task: Fail linkCAS after taking a node and then retry or abandon.
criteria.original_expected: The reserved node remains owned by the operation until linked or explicitly returned. A failed CAS cannot silently leak capacity or expose an uninitialized node.

changed_conditions.task: Implement a bounded cancellation path before publication and prove it cannot reclaim an already linked node.

criteria.original_task: Treat the ordinary-field identity helper as a concurrent pool merely because handles have generations.
criteria.original_expected: It requires external serialization; generation identity is not atomic ownership transfer. The queue pool instead CASes atomic state including retirement generation.

changed_conditions.task: Partition storage per worker and compare imbalance and stealing against an equal total-capacity shared pool.

criteria.original_task: Order loadSource,publishHazard,recheckSource,dereference against remove,retire,scan.
criteria.original_expected: Dereference follows a matching recheck; if removal/reuse invalidates the source, retry before access. Publishing after dereference or omitting recheck permits premature reuse.

changed_conditions.task: Relax one SC edge and give an actual memory-model argument or counterexample before accepting the optimization.

criteria.original_task: A collector retains old retired state2 while another collects,reuses and retires the same slot with a new tag.
criteria.original_expected: CAS must compare the entire retirement incarnation. Comparing only RETIRED can free a later protected lifetime; the retained collector_aba test deliberately rejects that stale CAS.

changed_conditions.task: Reduce tag space and require permanent retirement or an explicit reuse bound at exhaustion.

criteria.original_task: Pause one registered participant with hazards and continue all other queue operations.
criteria.original_expected: Protected retired nodes remain unavailable; safety can coexist with bounded-pool exhaustion. Participant IDs must be exclusive/nonreentrant and cannot be reassigned with stale hazards.

changed_conditions.task: Design deregistration that proves no outstanding reference before clearing slots, then compare retention against epochs.

criteria.original_task: Pause an enqueuer after successful tail.nextCAS but before updating tail.
criteria.original_expected: LinkCAS is enqueue publication; a second participant observes next and helps tail. Tail lag is not an empty queue and cannot justify blocking on the paused owner.

changed_conditions.task: Instrument a deterministic pause there and verify another enqueue/dequeue finishes with valid FIFO history.

criteria.original_task: Dequeue from dummyA to nextB while a reader protectsA and another collector runs.
criteria.original_expected: Successful headCAS linearizes removal; old dummyA retires and remains protected until hazards clear. Reading B payload requires protection before possible lifetime reuse.

changed_conditions.task: Interleave two dequeuers and prove exactly one removes each logical value while the losing operation retries safely.

criteria.original_task: All40000 distinct values are observed once in a stress test.
criteria.original_expected: This checks a finite execution and payload multiplicity, not every FIFO order, weak-memory schedule, fairness or progress bound. Link/output/history and allocator contracts still need proof.

changed_conditions.task: Generate short operation histories with actual invocation/response intervals and check them independently before benchmarking.

criteria.original_task: Participant0 enters epoch0; advance once then try again while it remains active.
criteria.original_expected: First advance to1 succeeds; second cannot pass the old active observer. A counter increment is not by itself reclamation permission for an arbitrary retired node.

changed_conditions.task: Associate retire epochs and derive the exact earliest reusable generation for every node.

criteria.original_task: Deregister an active stalled reader to relieve pool exhaustion.
criteria.original_expected: Removing metadata while it still holds references is unsafe; apparent progress cannot justify lifetime violation. Explicit FULL/retention is the correct bounded outcome absent quiescence.

changed_conditions.task: Add periodic quiescent points and compare memory retention with hazard protection under the same workload.

criteria.original_task: Run ordinary cmx_epoch fields concurrently without the documented serialization.
criteria.original_expected: That changes the API assumptions and can create C data races. A concurrent epoch implementation needs publication/order and nesting/reentry contracts, not just atomic counter substitution.

changed_conditions.task: Design fixed registration tickets and nonwrapping exhaustion under a selected C memory-order proof.

criteria.original_task: Reader0 enters root1; writer publishes2; reader1 enters2; reader0 leaves.
criteria.original_expected: Old root1 must survive reader0. The retained coarse quiescence check still waits for reader1 even though it sees2, a conservative liveness cost rather than a memory-safety failure.

changed_conditions.task: Compare captured preexisting readers with global-zero polling under an endless stream of new readers.

criteria.original_task: Attempt nested read on one participant or edit a currently published payload.
criteria.original_expected: Nested entry rejects in the declared nonnested API; published payload is immutable and caller-owned lifetime must extend through readers. Root-ID exchange alone does not enforce immutability in C.

changed_conditions.task: Add explicit nesting depth and derive correct outermost grace accounting without premature inactive publication.

criteria.original_task: Publish multiple versions while one reader never exits.
criteria.original_expected: Finite version storage eventually exhausts; the writer cannot free the protected old version to hide the bound. This teaching scheme is not Linux RCU or an automatic wait-free update guarantee.

changed_conditions.task: Compare a reader-writer lock using equal payload/capacity/shutdown contracts and separate reader cost from writer retention.

criteria.original_task: Enqueue7 completes before enqueue8, then dequeue returns8 without any earlier dequeue.
criteria.original_expected: No legal FIFO linearization exists. For overlapping enqueue/dequeue7, a witness may place enqueue first even if log row order differs.

changed_conditions.task: Use a stack specification and exhibit a history valid for one object and invalid for the other.

criteria.original_task: Two calls from one nonreentrant participant overlap; two different participants have equal coarse timestamps.
criteria.original_expected: Overlapping same-participant intervals reject. Strict response<invocation defines precedence in the supplied model; equal timestamps need declared clock/order resolution rather than silently inferred causal order.

changed_conditions.task: Add sequence-event IDs to disambiguate equal timestamps and check the stronger partial order.

criteria.original_task: Feed a pending operation or nine complete operations into the bounded checker.
criteria.original_expected: The current contract supports complete histories only and rejects beyond8; it does not prove pending-call completion semantics. Witness indices are implicit distinct operation identities.

criteria.original_task: Compare SPSC and MPMC throughput with different producer counts, capacities and allocation policies.
criteria.original_expected: Unequal contracts confound the result. Match admitted semantics and report every unavoidable difference; SPSC is not a drop-in multi-producer replacement.

changed_conditions.task: Vary payload size and affinity while holding correctness, shutdown and resource bounds fixed.

criteria.original_task: Measure under ASan and report only average throughput while one participant is paused.
criteria.original_expected: Sanitizer observations are correctness evidence, not production timing. Tail latency, retries, fairness and retained memory can reveal failures hidden by averages.

changed_conditions.task: Record raw distributions and repeated native runs with uncertainty, including an oversubscribed case where locking is faster.

criteria.original_task: A lock-free data path invokes blocking logging only on exhaustion.
criteria.original_expected: The complete operation includes that failure path, so its progress claim changes. Audit helper calls, allocation, collection and CPU scheduling assumptions rather than only the centralCAS.
